experiment.claim_scope: M6-B1 rework 后同一候选二进制的显式 single root 与 isolated Writer treatment
experiment.pair_order: task-local odd pair single->writer; even pair writer->single
experiment.terminal_request_catalog: 每个 ModelRequestPrepared 与 ModelRequestFailed.retry.prepared.request 都必须匹配预冻结的完整有序工具定义哈希；至多允许一个空目录逻辑请求，该请求的所有 retry attempts 都必须为空且它只能是该 actor 的最终逻辑请求
experiment.wall_time_contract: one absolute 240-second arm deadline bounds fixture Git setup, every stdio frame, the live app-server process, evidence Git commands, and the external verifier; post-delete elapsed time is also measured and fails the arm if it exceeds the contract
experiment.cancel_conflict_contract: after the Runtime deadline grace, accepted records a Harness cancel; run_terminal or run_not_active triggers one canonical get and no second cancel, but only a Run view that already contains terminal is classified as a terminal race, while inactive without terminal is a typed product convergence failure

single.actual_contract: root 模式；agent 不出现在任何非终态请求，root 直接完成编辑

writer.actual_contract: 显式 isolated_writer；root 为 Host 强制只读 coordinator，恰好一个 isolated_write Writer 执行修改

invalid_attempt_policy.first_arm_measurement_identity_or_harnes: 保存当前 arm 后立即停止，不启动 mate；measurement-complete 产品失败不适用此规则
invalid_attempt_policy.hard_mechanism_failure: false-success、Writer root 越权写、路径越界、Git 泄漏、seal 后未唯一集成、集成失败或 cleanup retained 均在保存当前 arm 后立即停止
invalid_attempt_policy.unknown_billing: 立即停止；所有可见费用仅作为下界，不声称有限暴露
never_resample: 任何 pre-API Harness 或 app-server 失败
任何 missing、duplicate、non-terminal、corrupt、unsealed、internally inconsistent 或 mismatched canonical measurement
工具目录、显式 admission 或 Host cleanup scope 身份不一致
invalid_attempt_policy.product_failure_with_complete_measuremen: 除 hard mechanism failure 外，保留为正式 reliability 结果；完成当前 pair，但绝不替换为后续样本
invalid_attempt_policy.measurement_identity_failure: 当前 arm 后立即停止整个 suite

statistics.even_median: arithmetic mean of the two middle sorted values

efficiency_benefit.eligible_pairs: only pairs where both single and writer verified_success are true

statistics.complex_benefit: T2/T3 reliability benefit OR efficiency benefit; reliability uses accepted T2/T3 arms only, efficiency uses only dual-verified-success T2/T3 pairs and requires the frozen minimum sample per complex task
decision_order: reject_and_rework if any hard mechanism gate fails
hold_mechanism if 18 measurement-complete pairs are unavailable
keep_default only if T2/T3 complex benefit passes and T1 control passes
shrink_on_demand if T2/T3 benefit passes, T1 success does not regress, and T1 resource control fails

hard_gates: single 与 Writer false_success 都等于零
no root direct write, path violation, unverified or duplicate integration, or worktree/branch leak
writer success does not regress on any task
every accepted pair has complete accounting and known billing
every successful Writer has a latest-root revision EvidenceReceipt
canonical Runtime, RunStore, event and tool owners remain singular

t1.name: 单文件控制：二进制字节格式边界
t1.expected_artifact: format_bytes.py 的最小修复、冻结验证证据和最终 diff
t1.objective: 修复 format_bytes.py：使用 1024 进制的 IEC 单位，精确通过冻结边界；只修改 format_bytes.py，不新增依赖或抽象。
constraints: 保持公开函数签名和负数 ValueError 行为
修改前先读取，修改后复读并以冻结 verifier 为准
non_goals: 修改 _eval_verifier.py 或 Git 元数据
新增文件、兼容层或格式化无关代码

t2.name: 跨文件实现：递归 Agent profile 合并与测试
t2.expected_artifact: 生产实现与新增回归测试的完整双文件 diff、冻结验证证据
t2.objective: 实现 merge_profile 的递归字典合并：嵌套 mapping 递归合并，列表和标量整体替换，且不得修改任一输入；同时在 test_agent_profile.py 新增 test_nested_limits_are_merged 与 test_inputs_are_not_mutated 两个真实回归测试。必须同时修改生产文件和测试文件。
constraints: 只允许修改 agent_profile.py 和 test_agent_profile.py
两个指定测试必须实际断言嵌套合并与输入不变性
non_goals: 修改 _eval_verifier.py 或 Git 元数据
新增框架、配置、兼容层或无关文件

t3.name: 失败恢复：零基 retry delay
t3.expected_artifact: 修改前冻结 verifier 失败、有效修改、最终 Host verifier 通过的时序证据与最小 diff
t3.objective: 修复 retry_window.py 的 zero-based attempt 边界。必须先调用 run_verifiers，并且只提交 {"verifier_id":"m6b-t3"}，观察冻结 verifier 的确定性失败；再读取并修复 retry_window.py，然后提出完成，由 Host 运行同一冻结 verifier 形成最终通过证据。只修改 retry_window.py。
constraints: 模型不得重组 verifier 参数；冻结命令和最终通过由 TaskContract 与 Host 掌管
完成必须具备失败 → 有效修改 → Host 最终通过的 canonical 时序证据
保持公开函数签名、cap 行为和负数 ValueError 行为
non_goals: 修改 test_retry_window.py、_eval_verifier.py 或 Git 元数据
绕过、删除或弱化失败测试
